newsitem.title: EGYPT: Upper Egypt Flour Mills 1995/6 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Upper Egypt Flour Mills 1995/6 profits up.

text.p: Upper Egypt Flour Mills made net after-tax profits of 42.428 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, 36 percent up on 31.192 million in 1994/5, according to audited results available on Sunday.
Turnover rose to 601.739 million pounds, 10.2 percent up on 545.821 million in the previous year, and profits before tax were 54.54 million, 27.9 percent up on 42.643 million.

The state sold the private sector at least 40 percent of the company's seven million shares earlier this month at 40.00 pounds a share. The shares rose on the Egyptian stock exchange on Sunday to a range of between 44.50 and 47.55 pounds.
